name: refund-tracker
title: Refund tracker
description: Where a refund is: requested, received, approved and paid out, with dates, the amount and the expected arrival once it is approved.
docs: refund holds the amount in minor units, where it goes, and steps: an ISO date for each step that has happened (requested, received, approved, paid). The latest step with a date is the current one; steps before it count as done. expectedBy is shown only once the refund is approved, and without it the item says Usually 3 to 5 working days after approval. Pass now from the server and a date that has passed is called late. refund.issue explains a failed refund (it stops at its step and shows reason and action) or a partial one (refunded is the amount that is paid). Always pass locale; labels holds every word, for another language.
